We isolate the beta multiplier's two NMOS transistors and source resistor, replacing the PMOS mirror with two equal current sources. Sweeping their common drain current using the existing transistor models with channel-length modulation shows the drain voltage required by $M_2$. The vertical lines mark the main current range where $M_2$ remains in saturation and its drain voltage stays below $5\,\mathrm{V}$.

![NMOS test circuit with equal injected drain currents, diode-connected $M_1$, and source-degenerated $M_2$.](beta_multiplier_nmos.svg){#fig-nmos-test-circuit width=600}
